Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Cyrillic

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Cyrillic
public class Cyrillic extends Object
Cyrillic-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_CYRILLIC section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x06.
